files.used_for: Finance Act, No. 11 of 1963, 95-page image scan with no text layer. A general Act whose section 51, under the marginal note 'Amendment of the First Schedule to Chapter 117', amends Part III of the First Schedule to the Registration of Documents Ordinance: in item 1, paragraph (a), the figures '1. 0' become '2. 0'; in item 3 the figures '0. 50' become '1. 0'. Classified ambiguous_or_unconfirmed as an omnibus Act: the First Schedule is printed in no held edition, so the change cannot be applied to any text.

statute_note: PRINCIPAL SOURCE SELECTED: the LankaLaw consolidated PDF (statutes/23-1927-registration-of-documents-ordinance.pdf, 22 pages, text layer, re-typed in macOS Pages, March 2025), parsed with parse_consolidated_pdf.py from PowerShell and hand-corrected; tree 23-1927-registration-of-documents-ordinance-consolidated.json, 42 sections in five printed chapters (I, II, III, V, VI) plus the s.16 repeal stub. OTHER SOURCES INSPECTED: the LankaLaw HTML edition (chain ends 5 of 1990; 50 sections), previously the baseline, now kept as the superseded edition file -consolidated-1990.json and used as the section-by-section cross-check; every held amending instrument's title page or header (listed in amendment_reconciliation); the Partition Act and Finance Act scans and OCR sidecars; the marriage-registration HTML (a different Act, excluded). CONSOLIDATION CUTOFF: Act No. 18 of 2024, from the page-1 chain header quoted in baseline.cutoff_evidence and the inline markers. REVIEW PERFORMED: one parser pass plus one hand-correction pass; word coverage 0.83% unmatched with the residue identified as the chain header and long title; enumerator sequence of the print read against the tree for ss.8, 26, 28, 32, 33, 35; every section's wording diffed against the HTML edition with each difference traced to an amending Act's own text or listed in quality_flags. Amending trees: 32 of 2022 proof-read against pdftoppm renders of all eleven scan pages, wording corrected, 31 corrections listed, OCR kept in raw_text; 21 of 2013 s.5 split out from the poppler text layer; 18 of 2024 headings and s.9 structure restored from the text layer; 48 of 2011, 50 of 1982, 19 of 1976 minor structural fixes; coverage 0.00% for 21 of 2013 and 18 of 2024 against their PDFs. AMENDMENT COVERAGE: 19 chain instruments plus the Partition Act, the Finance Act and the excluded marriage-registration file each have a reconciliation row; 13 already incorporated in the baseline; 6 known_but_not_held; 3 ambiguous_or_unconfirmed. Nothing was applied to the baseline text by hand. OCR OR STRUCTURAL WEAKNESSES: the PDF is a private re-typed transcription carrying its own OCR-like artefacts ('Us pendens' for 'lis pendens' in eleven places, 'Chapters IE or IV' in s.39, 'staled', 'description or the land', 'in within'), kept as printed and listed in the tree's suspect_readings because the HTML edition shares them and no held source supports a correction; republisher footnotes are printed inside ss.2(7), 3, 7(4), 11(7), 12(2), 14(3), 47 and kept; neither edition prints the First or Second Schedule (recorded in omitted_provisions with the Finance Act, 21 of 2013, 32 of 2022 and 18 of 2024 changes to them); 22 of 1958 remains an unproofed OCR tree; 32 of 2022 rests on one OCR reading proof-read by eye. MISSING SOURCES: Ordinances 19 of 1928, 22 of 1930, 14 of 1936, 34 of 1939, 13 of 1947 and Act 6 of 1949; the Schedules; the Gazette Order appointing the operative date of Act 18 of 2024. UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS: (1) section 12: Partition Act 16 of 1951 s.85(1) repeals 'section 12' of Cap. 101, yet both held editions print s.12 live and Law 14 of 1974 cross-refers to it; not marked repealed. (2) whether Act 18 of 2024 is in operation (s.1(2) appointed date). (3) commencement: HTML head date 1st January, 1928 against statute_commencement.csv 1927-01-01; the printed date is used. (4) s.39 still refers to Chapter IV after its repeal. LAWYER VERIFICATION: unverified. Every tree carries verification_status unverified.

baseline.publisher: not stated on the document; LankaLaw (private republisher) per the registry URL lankalaw.net/.../Registration-of-Documents-Consolidated-2024.pdf; PDF producer macOS Pages, 12 March 2025
baseline.decision: Option A. The PDF is the latest consolidated edition held (cutoff 18 of 2024 against the HTML's 5 of 1990). parse_consolidated_pdf.py (PowerShell/poppler) gave 42 sections at 1.42% unmatched on pass 1; after one hand-correction pass (chapter headings, s.8 proviso list, s.26(1)(a), s.28(2)(a), s.35(1)(a), s.32(1)(a)(i), s.33(1A)(a)(v)-(viii), s.33 and s.46 headings, s.3 tail) coverage is 0.83% with every unmatched word being the page-1 chain header or the long title, which live in metadata. Section by section against the HTML tree, every wording difference is one the four post-1990 Acts' own texts prescribe (s.13(1) 48/2011; s.13(6), s.48 21/2013; s.32, s.33, s.50 32/2022; s.8(b)(xii), s.16-24 repeal, Chapter V heading, s.25, s.29, s.41 18/2024), a genuine two-source cross-check, plus s.2(4) and s.35(2)-(3) which the HTML page lacks. The HTML tree is kept as a second, superseded edition file for the pre-repeal Chapter IV text. Section 12 is printed live in the PDF, so it is not marked repealed (see reconciliation row 16-1951).
